mentions.name: Tweet Toilet
mentions.description: A Chrome extension that opens a small text box for composing a post and sending it, letting users tweet without opening Twitter. Built to lower the friction of posting more often on Twitter.
mentions.problem: The author wants to increase their presence on Twitter by posting more, but dislikes going on Twitter itself.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I created a chrome extension that opens a small text box and I write my post there and send it.

https://tweettoilet.com
